# 60.00 USD arriving against a 100.00 USD invoice, parked in the CAD account.
#
# A part payment, which is ordinary — except that the block naming it claims
# 100.00 arrived. What the file asserts and what the bank holds disagree, and
# the guard for that compares the two figures.
#
# It skips itself when the account it is handed is not the record's currency,
# so handing it the CAD account turned it off for exactly the case the
# new sizing made reachable: measured, the invoice was settled by 60 while the
# file said 100, exit 0 and not a word.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD-quoted transaction whose bank side is less
# than the block claims.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-03 * "Money in, short"
	guid: "293a4b5c6d7e8f900112233445566778"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 60.00 USD
		guid: "3a4b5c6d7e8f9001122334455667788a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.39"
		value: "83.40"
	Assets:Due From Director -83.40 CAD
		guid: "4b5c6d7e8f9001122334455667788a9b"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-83.40"
